text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black decides not to run in the Satsuki Sho and simply observes it. There, she witnesses firsthand Brusquement's overwhelming victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, reporters press Air Groove for information about Brusquement. Kitasan Black's confidence is shattered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the Classic Triple Crown is just getting started. Sakura Bakushin O gives her some much needed encouragement, and Kitasan Black is able to keep pushing forward.
